_comment: Copy this to scripts/roster.json and fill in the real people.
roster.json is GITIGNORED on purpose: this repository is public, and a real
corporate directory (names + working email addresses) is exactly what gets
scraped for phishing. Never commit the real file.
role: 'ea' | 'ceo' | 'stakeholder'. Exactly one ea and one ceo are expected.
title: the person's Designation — shown beside their name when assigning
work and in the Stakeholder View (CR-01 / CR-02 #6).
email: must be unique. The schema enforces it, and auth lowercases it.
